cloover_snippet.title: AI Engineering & Automation Specialist (on-site)
cloover_snippet.description_text:
Your role

Every internal team at Cloover, Ops, Energy, Sales, CS, Finance, has work that AI agents can do faster and better. You'll build the systems that make that real: agentic pipelines, MCP servers, and internal tools that change how we operate day-to-day, not in some future roadmap. Success in this role means colleagues stop doing the work you've automated, and start doing the work only they can do.

You'll report to Florent (Head of Operations & Energy) and work within a team of amazing people alongside.

Your mission

- Design, build, and ship end-to-end agentic systems, RAG pipelines, embeddings, retrieval, prompt engineering, and evaluation, that automate Cloover's highest-volume internal workflows.

- Build and deploy custom MCP servers and integrations connecting HubSpot, Slack, Notion, Aircall, and other tools, so data flows where it needs to without manual work in between.

- Write production-grade Python and TypeScript with sound schema design, security, and authorization, code that ships and runs, not prototypes that sit.

- Own internal tooling end-to-end: spot the gap, build the tool, and deploy it on Firebase, Vercel, or GCP with proper version control and CI/CD.

- Build custom Claude Code skills, plugins, and connectors, then onboard colleagues into AI-native workflows that they actually keep using.

- Partner with Ops, Energy, Sales, CS, and Finance to identify the highest-leverage automation use cases, then personally implement them.

Your profile

We care more about how you think and what you've built than where you've been. Here's what will set you up for success in this role:

- You've shipped agentic systems, RAG pipelines, or AI-powered tools, in school, side projects, hackathons, or work, not just experimented with prompts in a chat window.

- You write production-grade Python and/or TypeScript and can defend the trade-offs in your code.

- You're comfortable wiring REST APIs, webhooks, and authentication across third-party tools (HubSpot, Slack, Notion, or similar) and can model data sensibly.

- You identify the gap, scope the solution, and ship it without waiting to be told what to do.

- Based in Berlin and energized by being in the room. We're intentionally office-first,  decisions get made in real time, prototypes get stress-tested over lunch, and the founding team is ten meters away. If that's how you thrive, you'll feel at home here.

Nice to have (but not required):

- Hands-on experience with MCP, Claude Code, or agentic frameworks like LangChain, CrewAI, or Google ADK.

- German language proficiency (B1 or above), useful for collaborating with the Ops & Energy team.

Don't meet every requirement? Apply anyway. We hire for potential and perspective,  credentials are a starting point, not a ceiling.

How we hire

We keep things transparent and respect your time. Most go from first call to offer in under three weeks.

- Intro call (30 min) — We want to understand what you're looking for, not just screen your CV.

- Hiring manager interview (30 min) — We go deep: your experience, your thinking, how you approach problems.

- Case study (1 hour) — You get the brief in advance. We care about your approach, not whether you land on the right answer.

- Offer & signed contract.

Need any adjustments at any stage? Just let us know.

Why us?

- Competitive pay. Fair compensation for your time and contribution, benchmarked to the Berlin internship market.

- AI-first & unthrottled. Unlimited enterprise-grade AI, no caps, no approval process. Every role, every team. The grunt work disappears so you can focus on what actually requires human judgement.

- Real ownership on a real mission. From day one you're shaping decisions that impact thousands of installers. We're not just building software, we're powering the energy transition across Europe.

- Grow faster than anywhere else. You'll work directly alongside the founding team and world-class investors. If you're building toward your own venture one day, there's no better room to be in.

- The basics, done well. Prenzlauer Berg office with the latest Apple hardware. Free breakfast and dinner, stocked kitchen, regular team events, 25 days vacation, Urban Sports Club (M), and company discounts.

Perks & Benefits
• Latest Apple hardware in our Prenzlauer Berg office
• 25 days vacation
• €500 per year learning & development budget
• WHOOP Peak, covered. After six months with us, we cover your WHOOP Peak membership in full
• Urban Sports Club (M) membership

• Cloover Power Tariff: our own green power tariff, with the monthly base fee on us

• Free dinner every day in the office (via Wolt)

About us
At Cloover, we’re building the AI operating system for the energy transition: a platform that helps thousands of installation companies across Germany and Austria sell more, plan faster, and deliver better. We’ve secured $1.32B in total financing: $1.3B in committed debt financing and a $22M Series A. We are just getting started on our European expansion.

Sales closes more because outreach is personalized at scale. Finance stress-tests in real time. People & Culture builds processes in a fraction of the time. Whatever your function, AI is how we punch above our weight, and it’s a skill you’ll develop here faster than almost anywhere else.
We believe the energy transition belongs to everyone, and so does our team. We’re international, driven, and deliberately inclusive. We hire for potential and perspective, and we welcome people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences.
Sound like your kind of challenge? Apply below.

pplwise_senior_ml.title: Senior AI / Machine Learning Engineer (m/f/d)
pplwise_senior_ml.description_text:
AI Agents to Bridge the Gap between Engineering & Purchasing to reduce manufacturing waste
My co-founder Ian and I combine over 15 years of industry experience, working with companies like SEW-Eurodrive, Terex, Bosch and Carl Zeiss. We co-founded Resourcly, a Project A-backed, industrial tech start-up to help industrial manufacturers streamline complex portfolios to improve EBIT while preventing and reducing idle inventory from being scrapped.

With our solution, we want to solve industry problems that we have tried to address for the last decade in the manufacturing companies we worked for, but that have so far been out of reach. With new technology and AI, that can finally happen.

Complex processes and products, lack of engineering talent and massive labour costs as well as a lack of intelligent automation have remained the industry's most pressing challenge. With LLMs and agents, we finally have the tools to solve this.

Our vision is that future purchasing and engineering processes will be orchestrated and run by an AI workforce - ensuring reliable and cost-efficient procurement and flow of goods in an uncertain and complicated world with finite resources.

🦾 We're already live with global manufacturing leaders in Europe
💰 Backed by one of Europe's top early-stage funds (Project A)
📈 Growing fast and hiring exceptional talent to join early

Our goal is to build a small, but excellent team, therefore we are looking for a Senior AI/ML Engineer. If you are excited to work in a very early-stage environment alongside the founding team, stellar data scientists and engineers, using AI at the product core to solve meaningful problems - please reach out.

The Role

As our Senior AI/ML Engineer, you will own the models that decide what our platform tells a customer, and the evidence that they are right. We turn technical drawings, datasheets and messy catalogue data from some of Europe's largest manufacturers into structured, comparable part data, and then answer the question everything rests on: are these two parts the same part? Customers make purchasing and engineering decisions on those answers, so a wrong answer costs more than a slow page.

This is a second senior hire into an existing applied-ML practice, with models already serving customers. You will work side by side with the engineer who owns our model pipelines today, report to our Head of Engineering, and collaborate closely with backend engineers, product and our customer-facing team. You will build and fine-tune models, and you will build the thing we are still missing: an evaluation strong enough to decide whether a model ships. This is neither a research role nor a platform role. You define the problem from the data, build the dataset, train the model, prove it, and put it on a GPU.

🪄 Key Responsibilities

• Build evaluation that can actually decide: Design leakage-safe splits, per-class quotas for the rare classes that matter, and power calculations before comparisons, then turn it into an automated gate and a durable record so every model change is adjudicable
• Fine-tune what we can serve: Train open-weight vision-language models on technical documents and own the cheaper models in front of them, select on the task metric rather than the loss curve, and kill your own model when a simpler approach wins
• Own datasets and ground truth: Define label taxonomies precisely, build ground truth where none exists, repair labels with clean provenance, and close the loop so human corrections become training data
• Keep training and serving identical: Own the parity between how features and preprocessing are computed at training time and in production, as executable checks rather than conventions
• Own serving, cost and throughput: Take a training run to a reproducible serving artefact on GPU, measure like for like, and pick the cost lever that actually applies
• Roll the pipeline out to the next customer: Stand up models for new customers in a multi-tenant setup, with thresholds and model identity that travel per customer and tenant isolation as a hard requirement
• Connect the model to the customer: Understand which mistakes are cheap and which are expensive, review real output with customers and colleagues, and explain a model's limits honestly to the people acting on it

🧑 🚀 Who You Are

• Intellectually honest: You report the number that makes you or your model look worse, and say plainly when a result cannot answer the question being asked
• Take full ownership: From dataset and training through serving, monitoring and rollback in production
• Bring startup mindset with high agency: Comfortable with ambiguity, because defining the problem, the benchmark and the metric is the first job
• Data before model: You look at the labels, the data and the preprocessing before reaching for a bigger model
• Low ego, strong teammate: You can inherit somebody else's code, name its strengths as readily as its faults, and improve it in place rather than rewriting it
• Curious about the domain: You want to know what a specification is and what the customer does with your answer
• Proactive communication: You write decisions down with their reason and their measurement, and share progress, blockers and trade-offs early

• 3 days in office (Mannheim, Berlin or Munich)
• Start: As soon as possible
• Compensation: Top of market (We're constrained by bandwidth, not demand - great time to negotiate)

bwi_full.title: Senior AI Engineer - Agentic Software Development (w/m/d)
bwi_full.description_text:
Sorge gemeinsam mit uns für die digitale Zukunftsfähigkeit der Bundeswehr.

Senior AI Engineer - Agentic Software Development (w/m/d)

ab sofort und in Vollzeit bundesweit an einem BWI Standort

Als primärer Digitalisierungspartner der Bundeswehr erbringen wir stabile, sichere und effiziente IT-Services im In- und Ausland, vom Grundbetrieb bis in den einsatznahen Bereich und tragen so zur kontinuierlichen Erhöhung der Führungs- und Einsatzfähigkeit der Bundeswehr bei. Mit über 8.000 Kolleg*innen betreiben und modernisieren wir eine der größten und komplexesten IT-Infrastrukturen in Deutschland. Wir suchen verantwortungsvolle IT-Spezialist*innen, die die Bundeswehr-IT aus Überzeugung in herausfordernden Digitalisierungsvorhaben weiterentwickeln und so einen Beitrag zur Sicherheit Deutschlands leisten wollen.

Wir im Technology Engineering Team sind als Teil vom Chief Technology Office (CTO) mitverantwortlich für die strategische Erneuerung des Leistungsportfolios der BWI. Unser Auftrag ist es eine KI-Service Plattform zu entwickeln und zu betreiben, über welche Mitarbeitende der BWI Zugriff auf modernste KI-Technologie erhalten. Hierzu verbinden wir Innovation und Forschung zur Künstlichen Intelligenz mit Best Practices aus DevSecOps und MLOps. Aktuell bauen wir ein starkes Team mit Expertise in unterschiedlichen Bereichen der KI-Entwicklung auf.
Werde auch Du Teil unseres Teams und unterstütze uns auf unserer gemeinsamen Mission!

Als Senior AI Engineer (m/w/d) entwickelst du unterschiedlichste KI-Lösungen konsequent agentisch und mit intensiver Unterstützung moderner Coding Assistants. Du steuerst den Entwicklungsprozess von Architektur und Implementierung bis zu Tests, Debugging und Weiterentwicklung und stellst dabei technische Qualität, Nachvollziehbarkeit und belastbare Ergebnisse sicher. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit hochspezialisierten Experten aus den Bereichen agentische Systeme, adaptive und selbstlernende KI, Computer Vision, neuronale Architekturen sowie Robotik zusammen. Entwicklung und Betrieb erfolgen in einer leistungsfähigen, sicherheitsorientierten On-Premises-Infrastruktur mit modernen GPU-Clustern für rechenintensive KI-Workloads, Modellbetrieb, Training und Evaluation.

Dein Profil:

-

Abgeschlossenes Studium (Master oder vergleichbar) im Bereich Informatik, Mathematik oder einer verwandten Fachrichtung

-

Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung nach dem Studium in professioneller Softwareentwicklung, davon mindestens 3 Jahre in der Entwicklung von KI-Lösungen

-

Nachweisbare berufliche Praxiserfahrung in überwiegend agentischer Softwareentwicklung mit Coding Agents als zentralem Entwicklungswerkzeug

-

Sehr starke Coding-Skills (u.a. Python, TypeScript) und fundiertes Verständnis moderner Softwarearchitekturen

-

Fundierte Kenntnisse in Machine Learning, Deep Learning und modernen KI-Technologien

-

Erfahrung mit APIs und verteilten Systemen ist von Vorteil

-

Hohes Maß an Selbstständigkeit, Ergebnisorientierung, Entscheidungsstärke und Teamkommunikation

-

Ausgeprägte Frustrationstoleranz und Pioniergeist für die Arbeit mit Technologien im Alpha- und Beta-Stadium

-

Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Deine Aufgaben:

-

Entwicklung anspruchsvoller KI-Lösungen mit einem konsequent agentischen Entwicklungsansatz

-

Intensive Nutzung und Steuerung moderner Coding Agents über den gesamten Entwicklungszyklus

-

Architektur, Implementierung, Review, Testing und Weiterentwicklung agentisch entwickelter Systeme

-

Überführung von Proofs of Concept und neuen KI-Ansätzen in belastbare produktive Lösungen

-

Integration von KI-Modellen, Agenten, Tools und externen Systemen zu ganzheitlichen Lösungen

-

Sicherstellung von technischer Qualität, Wartbarkeit, Performance und Nachvollziehbarkeit

Wir bieten:

- Durch abwechslungsreiche und gesellschaftlich relevante Aufgaben gewährleisten wir den reibungslosen IT-Betrieb und die Digitalisierung der Bundeswehr
- Das Ziel eint uns. Dabei sind für uns ein wertschätzender Umgang miteinander sowie ein großer Teamgeist elementar
- Wir bieten 30 Tage Jahresurlaub, 1 Brauchtumstag plus Optionen auf individuelle Anpassungen
- Über unsere Benefit-App erhält man ein monatliches Guthaben und kann sich zusätzlich Steuervergünstigungen auf Tickets für den ÖPNV sichern
- Wir ermöglichen Flexibilität, um Beruf und Privatleben in Einklang zu bringen, etwa durch mobiles Arbeiten oder Vertrauensarbeitszeit
- Wir unterstützen die berufliche und persönliche Weiterbildung durch individuelle Maßnahmen sowie einen kostenfreien Zugriff auf LinkedIn Learning
- Unser Jobradangebot ermöglicht das Leasing von bis zu 2 Fahrrädern
- Die Einstiegsvergütung liegt im Regelfall zwischen 87.700 € und 113.150 € brutto p.a. Die konkrete Höhe wird basierend auf Kriterien wie z.B. Qualifikation, Verantwortungsbereich und den Anforderungen der Position festgelegt. Gerechtfertigte Abweichungen sind im Einzelfall möglich

Sag's gerne weiter!

Frankfurt, Hamburg, München, Nürnberg, Ulm, Berlin, Bonn, Leipzig
